job: Hold a public page and give every section on it the same breakpoints, type steps, rhythm and grounds.
purpose: The grammar of a marketing site: a size container that every section measures instead of the viewport, fluid type that follows the type set, a section rhythm scaled by density, and seven grounds (the seventh, image, a picture behind the section with its text kept at 4.5:1 by a scrim). Fire ships no block library: variants differ in structure, never in decoration, and a site is told apart by its look and its composition. Never add a decorative variant.
useWhen: A public page: a landing page, pricing, a customer story, a changelog index.
Sections need to render the same inside a docs specimen or a Facet board as on the page.

avoidWhen.when: The page is a signed-in product screen.
A signed-out screen with one task: sign in, accept an invite.

states.name: contained
states.how: data-contained on .fd-site: a box for a specimen, nothing escapes it

variants.useWhen: The site sits in a box (docs specimens, a board), not on the page.
On a section: the page colour, the default.
On a section: half the block padding, for a logo strip or a short band.
On a hero or a closing call to action: a picture (an img in .fd-site-backdrop) behind the head, the section in the dark scheme over a darkened picture.
On an image ground: the light scheme over a lightened picture, for a pale picture and dark text.

parts.role: The shell; a size container named fd-site holding the header, main and the footer.
Every section carries it: rhythm, ground (data-ground page|sunken|raised|inverse|accent|texture), data-rhythm, data-rule.
Fluid hero type, about 40 to 72px, in the display face of the type set.
Fluid sub-section or large quote type, about 22 to 30px.
Fluid lead paragraph, about 17 to 20px, with a reading measure.
An index numeral (01, 02) in mono: the ornament of lists and eyebrows.
A product specimen made of Fire components inside an fd-doc-frame.
An image ground's picture: an img with alt="", width and height; data-position keeps a side; it takes data-treatment from its section.
